G21H.fTerm: OBTAINING ENERGY FROM RADIOACTIVE SOURCES; APPLICATIONS OF RADIATION FROM RADIOACTIVE SOURCES, NOT OTHERWISE PROVIDED FOR; UTILISING COSMIC RADIATION (measurement of nuclear or X-radiation G01T; fusion reactors G21B; nuclear reactors G21C; lamps in which a gas filling is excited to luminescence by external corpuscular radiation or by radioactive material structurally associated with the lamp H01J 65/04, H01J 65/06)

G21H1/00\\.ja: 放射線源から電気エネルギーを得るための装置，例．放射性同位元素から得るもの
G21H1/00\\.en: Arrangements for obtaining electrical energy from radioactive sources, e.g. from radioactive isotopes

G21H1/02\\.ja: ベータ線により直接帯電される素子
G21H1/02\\.en: Cells charged directly by beta radiation

G21H1/04\\.ja: アルファ線，ベータ線，ガンマ線により引き起こされる二次放射線を利用する素子
G21H1/04\\.en: Cells using secondary emission induced by alpha radiation, beta radiation, or gamma radiation

G21H1/06\\.ja: 放射線によって照射される異種半導体接合部を内部に有する素子
G21H1/06\\.en: Cells wherein radiation is applied to the junction of different semiconductor materials

G21H1/08\\.ja: 異なる二つの金属の接合部で放射線がガスをイオン化するような内部構造を有する素子，すなわち接触電位差素子
G21H1/08\\.en: Cells in which radiation ionises a gas in the presence of a junction of two dissimilar metals, i.e. contact potential-difference cells

G21H1/10\\.ja: 放射線が熱電接合または熱電子変換器を加熱する素子［２］
G21H1/10\\.en: Cells in which radiation heats a thermoelectric junction or a thermionic converter [2]

G21H1/12\\.ja: 放射線を光へ，光を光電子作用により電気エネルギーへ変換する素子
G21H1/12\\.en: Cells using conversion of the radiation into light combined with subsequent photoelectric conversion into electric energy

G21H3/00\\.ja: 放射線源からの放射線エネルギーを電気エネルギー以外のエネルギー，例．光，に直接変換する装置
G21H3/00\\.en: Arrangements for direct conversion of radiation energy from radioactive sources into forms of energy other than electric energy, e.g. light

G21H3/02\\.ja: 放射線により物質が励起され発光するもの（ガス封入物もしくはスクリーンまたは被膜が構造的にランプと結合した放射性材料によって励起され発光するランプＨ０１Ｊ６５／００）
G21H3/02\\.en: in which material is excited to luminesce by the radiation (lamps in which a gas filling or screen or coating is excited to luminesce by radioactive material structurally associated with the lamp H01J 65/00)

G21H5/00\\.ja: 放射線源からの放射線の応用またはそのための装置で，他の分類箇所に包含されないもの
G21H5/00\\.en: Applications of radiation from radioactive sources or arrangements therefor (producing mutation in plants A01H 1/06; preservation of dairy products A23C 3/07; preservation of foodstuffs A23L 3/26; for therapeutic purposes A61N 5/10; in chemical, physical or physicochemical processes in general B01J 19/08; in electrostatic separation B03C 3/38; for after-treatment of coatings applied as liquids or other fluent materials B05D 3/06; for action between electric vehicles and tracked apparatus B61L 1/10, B61L 3/06;  for preparation of organic chemical compounds C07, C08F 2/46; for treating macromolecular substances or articles made therefrom B29C 71/04, C08J 3/28, C08J 7/18; for cracking of hydrocarbon oils C10G 15/10, C10G 32/04; for reforming naphtha C10G 35/16; preservation or ageing of products obtained from fermentation processes C12H 1/06, C12H 1/16; for bleaching fibres D06L 3/04; measuring G01T; irradiation devices, gamma- or X-ray microscopes G21K; in discharge tubes H01J; apparatus for generating ions to be introduced into non-enclosed gases, e.g. into the atmosphere, H01T 23/00; for carrying-off electrostatic charges H05F 3/06)

G21H5/00A.ja: 空気等のイオン化に関するもの
G21H5/00A.en: Related to ionisation of air and the like

G21H5/00C.ja: 化学的プロセスに関するもの〔副分類〕

G21H5/00M.ja: 測定，検知，検査に関するもの
G21H5/00M.en: Related to measurement, detection, and inspection

G21H5/00R.ja: 鮮度保持に関するもの

G21H5/02\\.ja: トレーサとしての利用

G21H5/02A.ja: オートラジオグラフに関するもの

G21H5/02C.ja: 標的化合物に関するもの

G21H7/00\\.en: Use of effects of cosmic radiation
